connector.name: Maguyva
connector.registryDescription: Code intelligence for coding agents: semantic, AST, graph, and full-text search. 279+ languages.
connector.summary: Hosted at maguyva.tools over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.maguyva, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your Maguyva API key — free at maguyva.ai>. Alternative header: X-API-Key.
